refnamediv.refpurpose: Read signals and arrays from an hdf5 file.

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: This opcode requires the hdf5ops plugin and the HDF5 library. The plugin source is in the Csound 6 plugin tree. Install a plugin built for your Csound version. If Csound does not recognize the opcode, check that it has loaded the plugin.
hdf5read reads N signals and arrays from a specified hdf5 file.

refsect1.title: Syntax
refsect1.synopsis: xout1[, xout2, xout3, ..., xoutN] hdf5read ifilename, ivariablename1[, ivariablename2, ivariablename3, ..., ivariablenameN]

refsect1.title: Initialization
refsect1.para: ifilename -- the hdf5 file's name (in double-quotes).

ivariablename1[, ivariablename2, ivariablename3, ..., ivariablenameN] -- the names of the datasets (in double-quotes) to be read from the hdf5 file, if the dataset name is suffixed with an asterisk, e.g. "mydataset*", the entire dataset is copied to the array regardless of array type.

refsect1.title: Performance
refsect1.para: xout1,... xoutN -- The specified types of variables that the hdf5 datasets are to be read as. Datasets with a rank larger than 1 must be read as arrays, i-rate signals must also be read as i-rate signals. Other than these restrictions datasets may be read as any type of array or signal. When reading has reached the end of a dataset it no longer outputs any new values.

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: Run hdf5write.csd first and let it finish. It creates example.h5 in the current working directory with the datasets aArray, aVar, and kVar. Then run hdf5read.csd from the same directory. No separate dataset download is needed.
Keep the same sr and ksmps settings in both examples so the audio and control signals play back at the rates used to write them.
